steps.note: Cream and sugar are brought to the boil and boiled for 3 minutes.
The lemon juice is stirred in off the heat, and its acid thickens the cream.
It is cooled, then chilled for at least 4 to 6 hours until set.

sources.text: GoodToKnow for the modern lemon posset method; Wikipedia for possets being made from citrus juice, cream and sugar. The fridge temperature is an assumption of 'refrigerate' and not a sourced figure.
